heading.en: The twelve disciples minister unto the people and pray for the Holy Ghost—The disciples are baptized and receive the Holy Ghost and the ministering of angels—Jesus prays using words that cannot be written—He attests to the exceedingly great faith of these Nephites. About A.D. 34.
heading.sm: Ua auauna atu le au soo e toasefululua i tagata ma ua tatalo atu mo le Agaga Paia—Ua papatisoina le au soo ma ua latou maua le Agaga Paia ma le auaunaga a agelu—Ua tatalo Iesu ma ia faaaogaina upu e le mafai ona tusia—Ua molimau mai o ia i le faatuatua tele naua o nei tagata sa Nifaē. E tusa o le 34 T.A.

verses.en: And now it came to pass that when Jesus had ascended into heaven, the multitude did disperse, and every man did take his wife and his children and did return to his own home.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina ua mavae ona afio ae o Iesu i le lagi, sa taapeape atu le motu o tagata, ma sa taitasi le tane ma ave lana ava ma lana fanau ma foi atu i lona lava fale.

verses.en: And it was noised abroad among the people immediately, before it was yet dark, that the multitude had seen Jesus, and that he had ministered unto them, and that he would also show himself on the morrow unto the multitude.
verses.sm: Ma sa salalau vave atu le tala i totonu o le nuu atoa, ao lei po, e faapea sa vaai le motu o tagata ia Iesu, ma e faapea sa ia auauna mai ia te i latou; ma o le a ia toe faaali mai foi o ia lava i le aso e sosoo ai i le motu o tagata.

verses.en: Yea, and even all the night it was noised abroad concerning Jesus; and insomuch did they send forth unto the people that there were many, yea, an exceedingly great number, did labor exceedingly all that night, that they might be on the morrow in the place where Jesus should show himself unto the multitude.
verses.sm: Ioe, sa salalau atu lava le tala e uiga ia Iesu i le po atoa; ma o le tele o lo latou ta’u atu i tagata sa oo ina toatele ai, ioe, matua toatele lava le aofai o tagata, sa galulue malosi i lena po atoa, ina ia mafai ona latou i ai i le aso e sosoo ai i le nofoaga lea o le a faaali mai ai e Iesu o ia lava i le motu o tagata.

verses.en: And it came to pass that on the morrow, when the multitude was gathered together, behold, Nephi and his brother whom he had raised from the dead, whose name was Timothy, and also his son, whose name was Jonas, and also Mathoni, and Mathonihah, his brother, and Kumen, and Kumenonhi, and Jeremiah, and Shemnon, and Jonas, and Zedekiah, and Isaiah—now these were the names of the disciples whom Jesus had chosen—and it came to pass that they went forth and stood in the midst of the multitude.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le aso na sosoo ai, ina ua faapotopoto faatasi le motu o tagata, faauta, o Nifae ma lona uso na ia faatu mai le oti, o Timoteo lona igoa, ma lona atalii foi, o Iona lona igoa, ma Matonae foi, ma Matonaea lona uso, ma Kumeni, ma Kumenonae, ma Ieremia, ma Semoni, ma Iona, ma Setekaia, ma Isaia— o lenei o igoa ia o le au soo na filifilia e Iesu— ma sa oo ina latou o atu ma tutulai i le totonugalemu o le motu o tagata.

w.en: whom he raised from the dead,
these are the names of the disciples

verses.en: And behold, the multitude was so great that they did cause that they should be separated into twelve bodies.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, sa matua toatele naua le motu o tagata sa latou faatonu ia vaevaeina i latou i ni vaega e sefululua.

verses.en: And the twelve did teach the multitude; and behold, they did cause that the multitude should kneel down upon the face of the earth, and should pray unto the Father in the name of Jesus.
verses.sm: Ma sa a’oa’o e le toasefululua le motu o tagata; ma faauta, sa latou faatonu atu ia tootutuli i lalo le motu o tagata i luga o le eleele, ma ia latou tatalo atu i le Tamā i le suafa o Iesu.

verses.en: And the disciples did pray unto the Father also in the name of Jesus. And it came to pass that they arose and ministered unto the people.
verses.sm: Ma sa tatalo atu foi le au soo i le Tamā i le suafa o Iesu. Ma sa oo ina latou tutulai ma auauna atu i tagata.

verses.en: And when they had ministered those same words which Jesus had spoken—nothing varying from the words which Jesus had spoken—behold, they knelt again and prayed to the Father in the name of Jesus.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona latou fai atu o ia lava upu na fetalai iai Iesu— sa leai se mea na ese mai upu na fetalai iai Iesu— faauta, sa latou toe tootutuli ma tatalo atu i le Tamā i le suafa o Iesu.

verses.en: And they did pray for that which they most desired; and they desired that the Holy Ghost should be given unto them.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou tatalo atu mo lena mea na sili ona latou mananao i ai; ma sa latou mananao ia tuuina mai le Agaga Paia ia te i latou.

w.en: that the Holy Ghost be given

verses.en: And when they had thus prayed they went down unto the water’s edge, and the multitude followed them.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona latou tatalo faapea sa latou o ifo i le autafa o le vai, ma sa mulimuli atu le motu o tagata ia te i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Nephi went down into the water and was baptized.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ai ina alu ifo Nifae i totonu o le vai ma ua papatisoina ai.

verses.en: And he came up out of the water and began to baptize. And he baptized all those whom Jesus had chosen.
verses.sm: Ma sa tulai ae o ia mai le vai ma amata ona papatiso atu. Ma sa ia papatisoina i latou uma o e na filifilia e Iesu.

verses.en: And it came to pass when they were all baptized and had come up out of the water, the Holy Ghost did fall upon them, and they were filled with the Holy Ghost and with fire.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona papatisoina i latou uma ma o ae mai le vai, sa afio ifo le Agaga Paia i luga o i latou, ma sa faatumuina i latou i le Agaga Paia ma le afi.

verses.en: And behold, they were encircled about as if it were by fire; and it came down from heaven, and the multitude did witness it, and did bear record; and angels did come down out of heaven and did minister unto them.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, sa siomia i latou e peiseai ua siomia i se afi; ma sa alu ifo mai le lagi, ma sa vaai i ai le motu o tagata, ma latou molimau ai; ma sa afifio ifo agelu mai le lagi ma auauna atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that while the angels were ministering unto the disciples, behold, Jesus came and stood in the midst and ministered unto them.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina a o auauna atu agelu i le au soo, faauta, sa afio mai Iesu ma ua tulai i le totonugalemu ma auauna atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he spake unto the multitude, and commanded them that they should kneel down again upon the earth, and also that his disciples should kneel down upon the earth.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina fetalai atu o ia i le motu o tagata, ma poloaiina i latou ia latou toe tootutuli i lalo i luga o le eleele, ma ia tootutuli foi ona soo i lalo i luga o le eleele.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when they had all knelt down upon the earth, he commanded his disciples that they should pray.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona latou tootutuli uma i lalo i luga o le eleele, sa ia poloai atu i ona soo ia latou tatalo.

verses.en: And behold, they began to pray; and they did pray unto Jesus, calling him their Lord and their God.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, sa amata ona latou tatalo; ma sa latou tatalo atu ia Iesu, ua ta’ua o ia o lo latou Alii ma lo latou Atua.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Jesus departed out of the midst of them, and went a little way off from them and bowed himself to the earth, and he said:
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina maliu ese atu Iesu mai i le totonugalemu o i latou, ma maliu ese teisi mai ia te i latou ma punou o ia lava i le eleele, ma ia fetalai atu:

verses.en: Father, I thank thee that thou hast given the Holy Ghost unto these whom I have chosen; and it is because of their belief in me that I have chosen them out of the world.
verses.sm: Le Tamā e, ou te faafetai atu ia te oe ona ua e tuuina mai le Agaga Paia ia te i latou nei o e ua ou filifilia; ma ona o lo latou talitonu ia te au ua ou filifilia ai i latou mai le lalolagi.

w.en: that you have given the Holy Ghost

verses.en: Father, I pray thee that thou wilt give the Holy Ghost unto all them that shall believe in their words.
verses.sm: Le Tamā e, ou te tatalo atu ia te oe ia e tuuina atu le Agaga Paia ia te i latou uma o e o le a talitonu i a latou upu.

w.en: that you give the Holy Ghost

verses.en: Father, thou hast given them the Holy Ghost because they believe in me; and thou seest that they believe in me because thou hearest them, and they pray unto me; and they pray unto me because I am with them.
verses.sm: Le Tamā e, ua e tuuina mai ia te i latou le Agaga Paia ona ua latou talitonu mai ia te au; ma ua e silasila ua latou talitonu mai ia te au ona ua e faafofogaina i latou, ma ua latou tatalo mai ia te au; ma ua latou tatalo mai ia te au ona o loo ou faatasi ma i latou.

verses.en: And now Father, I pray unto thee for them, and also for all those who shall believe on their words, that they may believe in me, that I may be in them as thou, Father, art in me, that we may be one.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei le Tamā e, ou te tatalo atu ia te oe mo i latou, ma i latou uma foi o e o le a talitonu i a latou upu, ina ia latou talitonu ia te au, ina ia mafai ona ou i ai i totonu o i latou e pei ona i ai oe, le Tamā, i totonu ia te au, ina ia tasi i tatou.

w.en: that they may believe in me,

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Jesus had thus prayed unto the Father, he came unto his disciples, and behold, they did still continue, without ceasing, to pray unto him; and they did not multiply many words, for it was given unto them what they should pray, and they were filled with desire.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona tatalo atu faapea o Iesu i le Tamā, sa maliu mai o ia i ona soo, ma faauta, sa latou faaauau pea, e aunoa ma le taofia, le tatalo atu ia te ia; ma sa latou le faateleina ni mau upu, ona sa tuuina atu ia te i latou mea e tatau ona latou tatalo atu ai, ma sa tumu i latou i manaoga.

w.en: for it was given to them

verses.en: And it came to pass that Jesus blessed them as they did pray unto him; and his countenance did smile upon them, and the light of his countenance did shine upon them, and behold they were as white as the countenance and also the garments of Jesus; and behold the whiteness thereof did exceed all the whiteness, yea, even there could be nothing upon earth so white as the whiteness thereof.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faamanuiaina i latou e Iesu a o latou tatalo atu ia te ia; ma sa soisoi ifo ona fofoga ia i latou, ma sa susulu ifo le malamalama o ona fofoga i o latou luga, ma faauta sa sinasina i latou e faapei o fofoga ma laei foi o Iesu; ma faauta o lo latou sinasina sa silisili atu i le sinasina o mea uma, ioe, e moni e leai se mea i luga o le lalolagi e mafai ona sinasina e pei o lenei.

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them: Pray on; nevertheless they did not cease to pray.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai atu Iesu ia te i latou: Ia outou tatalo pea; ae ui i lea sa le tuua lava le tatalo atu.

verses.en: And he turned from them again, and went a little way off and bowed himself to the earth; and he prayed again unto the Father, saying:
verses.sm: Ma sa ia toe liliu ese mai ia te i latou, ma ua maliu teisi ese atu ma ua punou o ia lava i le eleele; ma sa ia toe tatalo atu i le Tamā, ua fetalai atu:

verses.en: Father, I thank thee that thou hast purified those whom I have chosen, because of their faith, and I pray for them, and also for them who shall believe on their words, that they may be purified in me, through faith on their words, even as they are purified in me.
verses.sm: Le Tamā e, ou te faafetai atu ia te oe ona ua e faamamaina i latou ia o e ua ou filifilia, ona o lo latou faatuatua, ma ou te tatalo atu mo i latou, ma i latou foi o e o le a talitonu ia latou upu, ina ia faamamaina i latou ia te au, e ala i le faatuatua ia latou upu, e pei ona faamamaina i latou ia te au.

w.en: through the faith in their words,

verses.en: Father, I pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me out of the world, because of their faith, that they may be purified in me, that I may be in them as thou, Father, art in me, that we may be one, that I may be glorified in them.
verses.sm: Le Tamā e, ou te le tatalo mo le lalolagi, ae mo i latou ua e tuuina mai ia te au mai le lalolagi, ona o lo latou faatuatua, ina ia faamamaina i latou ia te au, ina ia mafai ona ou i ai i totonu o i latou e pei ona i ai oe, le Tamā, i totonu ia te au, ina ia tasi i tatou, ina ia faamamaluina ai a’u ia i latou.

verses.en: And when Jesus had spoken these words he came again unto his disciples; and behold they did pray steadfastly, without ceasing, unto him; and he did smile upon them again; and behold they were white, even as Jesus.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua uma ona fetalai atu Iesu i nei upu sa toe maliu mai o ia i ona soo; ma faauta sa latou tatalo pea e le aunoa, ia te ia; ma sa ia soisoi alofa ifo foi ia i latou; ma faauta ua sinasina i latou, e faapei lava o Iesu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he went again a little way off and prayed unto the Father;
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina toe afio ese teisi o ia ma ua tatalo atu i le Tamā;

verses.en: And tongue cannot speak the words which he prayed, neither can be written by man the words which he prayed.
verses.sm: Ma e le mafai ona tautala le laulaufaiva i upu na ia tatalo atu ai, pe mafai foi e se tagata ona tusia upu na ia tatalo atu ai.

verses.en: And the multitude did hear and do bear record; and their hearts were open and they did understand in their hearts the words which he prayed.
verses.sm: Ma sa faalogo i ai le motu o tagata ma latou molimauina; ma sa matala o latou loto ma sa malamalama i o latou loto upu ia na ia tatalo ai.

verses.en: Nevertheless, so great and marvelous were the words which he prayed that they cannot be written, neither can they be uttered by man.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, sa matua silisili ma ofoofogia naua upu na ia tatalo atu ai e le mafai ona tusia i latou, pe le mafai foi ona tautalaina e le tagata.

verses.en: And it came to pass that when Jesus had made an end of praying he came again to the disciples, and said unto them: So great faith have I never seen among all the Jews; wherefore I could not show unto them so great miracles, because of their unbelief.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua uma ona faaiu e Iesu le tatalo atu, sa toe maliu mai o ia i ona soo, ma fetalai mai ia te i latou: Ou te lei vaai lava i se faatuatua tele faapea i totonu o tagata Iutaia uma; o lea sa le mafai ai ona ou faaali atu ia te i latou o ni vavega tetele faapea, ona o lo latou le talitonu.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, there are none of them that have seen so great things as ye have seen; neither have they heard so great things as ye have heard.
verses.sm: E moni ou te fai atu ia te outou, e leai se tasi o i latou ua vaai i ni mea silisili faapea e pei ona outou vaai i ai; pe ua latou faalogo foi i ni mea silisili faapea e pei ona outou faalogo i ai.

w.en: who have seen such great things
